shell_commands_self_reported.command: find ./docs -type f -not -path '*/.*' -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 ls -l 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; find ./docs 2>/dev/null | head -100; echo "--- reports:"; ls -la ./reports 2>/dev/null
for f in ./docs/html/*.html ./docs/csv/*.csv ./docs/text/*.txt; do echo "== $f"; wc -c < "$f"; wc -l < "$f"; file -b "$f"; done

for f in ./docs/html/*.html; do echo "== $f"; grep -i -o -m1 '<title[^>]*>[^<]*</title>' "$f"; grep -i -m1 -E '<h1[^>]*>' "$f"; done; for f in ./docs/text/*.txt; do echo "== $f"; grep -m1 -v '^[[:space:]]*$' "$f"; done
for f in ./docs/csv/*.csv; do echo "== $f"; head -1 "$f"; echo "lines: $(wc -l < "$f")"; awk -F',' 'NR==1{print "cols:", NF}' "$f"; done

wc -c docs/html/release-faq.html docs/html/status-page.html docs/html/onboarding-guide.html docs/html/pricing-table.html docs/csv/staff-roster.csv docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv docs/text/meeting-notes.txt docs/text/style-guide.txt docs/text/changelog.txt && wc -l docs/html/rele

grep -i -o -m1 '<title[^>]*>[^<]*</title>' docs/html/release-faq.html docs/html/status-page.html docs/html/onboarding-guide.html docs/html/pricing-table.html; grep -i -m1 '<h1' docs/html/release-faq.html docs/html/status-page.html docs/html/onboarding-guide.html docs/html/pricing-table.html; grep -m

head -1 docs/csv/staff-roster.csv docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv; awk -F',' 'FNR==1{print FILENAME, "cols:", NF}' docs/csv/staff-roster.csv docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv; wc -l docs/csv/staff-roster.csv docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv

wc -c docs/html/release-faq.html docs/html/status-page.html docs/html/onboarding-guide.html docs/html/pricing-table.html docs/csv/staff-roster.csv docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv docs/text/meeting-notes.txt docs/text/style-guide.txt docs/text/changelog.txt

wc -l docs/html/release-faq.html docs/html/status-page.html docs/html/onboarding-guide.html docs/html/pricing-table.html docs/csv/staff-roster.csv docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv docs/text/meeting-notes.txt docs/text/style-guide.txt docs/text/changelog.txt
